caption: R1 400 on takeaways and data and I barely noticed. Is R2 500 for black tax normal where you're from?

slides.title:
How I spend
my R12 400
p/m salary
Living in Ficksburg
slides.body:
Female, 27
Single, no kids
Job: Crèche teacher (ECD practitioner)
Net salary: R12 400 p/m

slides.title: Rent
slides.includes: Backroom in Meqheleng, water, prepaid electricity
slides.body: One room and a shared tap. I stopped pretending it's more than that and started enjoying the quiet.

slides.title: Black tax
slides.includes: My gran's groceries, my brother's school fees
slides.body: I send it the day after payday. If I wait, I start negotiating with myself.

slides.title: Taxi fare
slides.includes: Daily to the crèche, weekends home to Clocolan
slides.body: Two taxis each way on weekends. R1 500 and it still feels like a surprise.

slides.title: Groceries
slides.includes: Pick n Pay, the spaza, a bag of mealie meal
slides.body: I buy snacks for the kids at work and end up eating half of them.

slides.title: Takeaways & data
slides.includes: Kota twice a week, data bundles
slides.body: R1 400 is the number I'm not proud of. Data alone is R650 and I'm on WhatsApp all day.

slides.title: Everything else
slides.includes: Funeral policy, stokvel, phone contract, clothing account, toiletries, savings
slides.body: The stokvel and funeral policy go off my account before I can touch them. The rest is small things that add up.

slides.title: What's left
slides.body: Out of R12 400. It's gone by the 22nd most months, and then it's rice and eggs until the 25th.

slides.title: I stopped guessing
slides.body:
I uploaded my statements to Beyond Horizon and it sorted every transaction into categories.

The takeaways and data number made me go quiet.

No bank login needed.
